name: Lipase-driven chylomicron remodeling and triglyceride catabolism
rationale: All members concern lipase (LPL/LIPC) hydrolysis of triglycerides and phospholipids in chylomicrons and their clearance, whereas confusables centre on VLDL/LDL/HDL remodeling and assembly.

name: MicroRNA-mediated mRNA silencing and IGF2BP-mediated stabilization
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC, miRNA/ceRNA/lncRNA silencing of specific targets and its counterpart IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization, unlike confusables focused on ARE-binding decay, siRNA or mRNA 3'-end processing.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and gland branching
rationale: Members describe mesenchyme-epithelium inductive signaling and branching of lung, trachea, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands plus related bud outgrowths, whereas confusables concern mammary, gonadal and pancreatic development.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGF-beta receptor-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ growth control (cell density, YAP transcription) with oncogenic TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3 mutants; Hippo distinguishes it from the TGFBR/SMAD4 mutant confusable and the SMAD2/3 mutants from the others.

name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing driving IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA and cytosolic DNA/ZBP1 sensing leading to IRF3-mediated type I IFN and IP-10, unlike confusables centred on helicase/IRF7 TLR routes, OAS or interferon-alpha response.

name: IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 and IL-17 cytokine receptor signaling
rationale: All members are receptor signaling of IL-33, IL-36, IL-38 or IL-17, while confusables add IL-1/IL-18 processing, Th17 production or IL-12/IL-23 and C-type lectin signaling.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and endothelial shear-stress response
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation and SRF-driven contractile genes together with endothelial responses to flow, distinct from cardiac muscle and angiogenesis confusables.

name: Sperm flagellum assembly and motility in spermiogenesis
rationale: Members concern sperm axoneme, mitochondrial sheath, manchette and flagellar motility during spermiogenesis, unlike confusables about motile-cilium dynein arms, ciliogenesis or early germ cells.

core: Nuclear pore transport and envelope remodeling
name: Nuclear pore transport, SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members span nuclear pore protein/ribosome/IP transport, the SUMO conjugation cascade and mitotic nuclear envelope/NPC breakdown and reformation, whereas confusables emphasize ESCRT sealing or mRNA export.

qualifier: antigen presentation to CD8 T cells
name: IFN-gamma-driven MHC expression and CD8 T cell antigen presentation
rationale: Members regulate MHC class I/II biosynthesis and IFN-gamma response linked to T cell antigen presentation and CD8 T cell proliferation, unlike confusables on Th1 differentiation and IFNG signaling regulation.

name: Calcium/CaMK-CREB synapse-to-nucleus signaling in memory
rationale: Members link NMDAR calcium to CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV-CREB, AMPK and NPAS4 transcription supporting LTP and memory, unlike confusables on cAMP-PKA, NMDAR channel function or MECP2.

name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial and epithelial barrier permeability
rationale: Members concern tight junction assembly, disassembly and paracellular barrier function in gut, vessels and blood-brain barrier, distinct from adherens junction and mechanosensing confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine incorporation and thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members cover selenium compound metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis/readthrough and selenoprotein-dependent thyroid hormone generation and transport, unlike confusables on ROS detoxification, sulfonation or thyroid receptor signaling.

name: Cullin-RING ligase neddylation cycle and RHOBTB GTPases
rationale: Members concern cullin neddylation/deneddylation by the COP9 signalosome, a CUL1 substrate and the RHOBTB CUL3 adaptors, unlike confusables on PD-L1 degradation or generic proteolysis.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac and skeletal contraction
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA reuptake and Na/Ca exchange that set muscle contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on store-operated calcium entry or chemical heart-rate control.

name: Mitochondrial fission-fusion dynamics and PINK1-Parkin mitophagy
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial fission, fusion and depolarisation-induced PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein targeting or receptor-mediated mitophagy.

name: Rho-family GTPase cycles and effector activation of actin
rationale: Members are RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles and their effectors (ROCK, PAK, CIT, formins, WASP/WAVE) driving actin protrusion, unlike confusables listing actin dynamics or upstream G12/13 activation.

name: Leukocyte G-protein beta-gamma to Rac signaling in migration
rationale: Members link GPCR beta-gamma (PLC-beta, PI3K-gamma), S1P receptors and RAC1/RAC2/RHOH-NADPH oxidase to leukocyte homing and chemotaxis, unlike confusables on T cell synapse or chemokine ligands.

name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are IL-6, LIF and CNTF receptor signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation, distinct from IL-11, IL-27, CSF1 and IL-2-family confusables.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovulation, luteinization and testis development
rationale: Members cover FSH/LH secretion and response, ovarian cycle events and Sertoli/Leydig/seminiferous development, unlike confusables on oocyte maturation and activin signaling.

name: Polyubiquitin chain types and proteasome-dependent protein degradation
rationale: Members cover E3 ligases, K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation, degron pathways and regulation of proteasomal catabolism, unlike confusables on ERAD quality control, deubiquitination or ribosome quality control.

qualifier: sex steroids and steroidogenic CYP deficiencies
name: Sex steroid biosynthesis and steroidogenic CYP enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, androgen and estrogen synthesis and inherited steroidogenic CYP defects, whereas confusables centre on glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis.

name: Nutrient and energy regulation of mTORC1 signaling
rationale: All members concern mTORC1 activation by amino acids and its LKB1-AMPK energy control, unlike confusables on amino-acid transport or mTORC1/p53 metabolic outputs.

name: Influenza vRNP assembly and nuclear viral RNA synthesis
rationale: Members are influenza vRNA and mRNA synthesis and vRNP assembly in the host nucleus, distinct from coronavirus replication and HIV integration confusables.

name: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development, catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members cover neural crest migration into sympathetic, adrenal and enteric lineages with endothelin signaling and catecholamine synthesis, unlike confusables on GI motility or RET/GDNF signaling.
